messages.text:
Hello,

I would like to ask whether the order will be shipped from within the European Union (EU), or from outside the EU.

I am asking because I would like to avoid any additional import duties, customs fees or VAT charges upon delivery.

The Magic Miner 40T ships from outside the EU. For an EU address the $799 doesn't include VAT. The carrier or customs charges 21% import VAT on delivery, and any duty is yours to pay. Checkout doesn't collect it, and I can't quote the exact amount your customs office will charge.

Which country are you in? Some smaller units ship from our EU stock with import VAT already included.
Slovenia
Searched the catalog · bitcoin miner EU

For S., the Magic Miner 40T is $799 plus $40 flat shipping, both shown at checkout. It ships from outside the EU, so the carrier or customs collects 21% import VAT on delivery, plus any duty. On the unit price alone that's about $168, but your customs office sets the final amount. This batch ships December 14, 2026.

If you'd rather pay nothing on delivery, the one miner we have in EU stock right now is the Hammer DC02 (EU plug) at $239.99, with VAT already included. It ships in about 2 business days, but it mines Dogecoin and Litecoin, not Bitcoin.

Are you set on Bitcoin, or is the DC02 worth a look?
